resources.string: Offline voice typing for any app. Speech is turned into text on this phone. The app has no internet permission, so nothing you say can leave the device.
The phone\'s speech service isn\'t available. Choose Whisper in Spokify\'s settings.
Phone speech isn\'t available on this phone, so Whisper is being used.
The phone\'s speech service couldn\'t work offline. Check the offline language pack for this language is installed (Settings → search \"Offline language pack\").
This language isn\'t available offline. Install its offline language pack (Settings → search \"Offline language pack\").
The phone\'s speech service needs microphone permission. Allow it in Settings → Apps → Samsung voice input (or Google) → Permissions.
The phone\'s speech service is busy. Try again in a moment.
The phone\'s speech service stopped (error %1$d). Try again, or choose Whisper in settings.
Reached the 15-minute limit, so recording stopped. Typing what you said…
Loading the speech model (first use only)…
Didn\'t catch that. Tap the mic and try again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Microphone access needed. Open the app to allow it.
Couldn\'t open the microphone. Another app may be using it.
The text box closed, so your dictation was saved in History.
Android blocked the microphone. Open Spokify once, then try again.
Turn on \"Spokify Keyboard\" in the list. Android will warn that keyboards can see what you type; this one has no internet access, so it can\'t send anything anywhere.
Optional. You can also switch any time with the keyboard icon at the bottom of the screen.
Another keyboard is active. Use the keyboard icon at the bottom of the screen, or tap below.
A mic bubble appears whenever a keyboard is open. Hold it and speak, let go to type. Slide away to cancel; drag it to move it. You can keep using your normal keyboard.
In the list, tap "Installed apps" or "Downloaded apps" if you see it, then "Spokify floating mic", and switch it on.

If the switch is greyed out ("Restricted setting"), open App info for Spokify, tap ⋮ at the top right, choose "Allow restricted settings", then try again. Android does this for apps installed outside the Play Store.
Off: it only appears while a keyboard is open.
Hold the mic while you speak
No text box found, so the text was copied. Long-press a text box and tap Paste.
Dictation is not typed into password boxes

Shows a floating mic over other apps. Hold it and speak, and your words are typed into the text box you are in. It only reads the text box you are typing in, so it can put your words at the cursor. Speech is processed on this phone, and the app has no internet permission.

Uses an AI service you choose to tidy each dictation further: smoother sentences, better grammar and lists. When this is on, the text of each dictation (never the audio) is sent to that service using your own API key, and you pay the provider for usage. Check your employer\'s policy before using it for work. If the AI can\'t be reached, Spokify types its own version instead.
Key saved (ends in %1$s). Stored encrypted on this phone. Paste a new one to replace it.
No key saved for this service yet.
Leave empty to use %1$s (recommended). You can enter another Claude model, e.g. claude-haiku-5-5 for faster, cheaper polishing.
Enter a model name from your provider\'s list. A small, fast model works best for dictation.
Leave empty to use %1$s (recommended: about 1–2 seconds and faithful in testing). Full \"flash\" or \"pro\" models can take much longer, and Spokify gives up after about 20 seconds.
Light touch: fix grammar, keep my words
um so i think we should uh move the meeting to friday no wait monday at ten and then can you send the the invoice summary to finance
AI polish unavailable (%1$s). Typed Spokify\'s own version.
Tap here, switch to Spokify Keyboard, then tap the mic.

Phone: uses your phone\'s own speech recognition and its offline language packs. Much better with Malaysian English and supports Bahasa Melayu. Spokify asks it to work offline; Spokify itself has no internet access, but the listening is done by the phone\'s speech service.\nWhisper: everything stays inside Spokify. English only, and less accurate with accents.
✗ No phone speech service found. Spokify will use Whisper.
Needs the matching offline language pack: Settings → search \"Offline language pack\". Malay spoken punctuation: \"koma\", \"noktah\", \"tanda soal\", \"baris baru\".
Start listening when the keyboard opens
Switch to Spokify Keyboard and just speak. Not in password boxes.

After your words are typed, returns to the keyboard you were using (e.g. Samsung Keyboard). Tip: turn on Settings → Keyboard list and default → \"Show input method button on navigation bar\" to switch with one tap.

Turns speech into text sentence by sentence while you are still talking, so long dictations appear almost as soon as you stop. Turn off if accuracy seems lower; the whole recording is then processed in one go when you finish.
\"Friday, no wait, Monday\" becomes \"Monday\". Also say \"scratch that\" to drop what you just said. Fixes repeated words (\"the the\"), \"a\" / \"an\", a lowercase \"i\" and missing full stops.
Say \"comma\", \"full stop\", \"question mark\", \"new line\" or \"new paragraph\".
Stores your last 50 dictations on this phone so you can copy them again. Turning it off deletes them.
Names and terms to spell correctly, separated by commas.
e.g. Oracle, OTC, AR aging, vendor master
Nothing yet. Tap an item to copy it.

Speech engines: the phone\'s own speech recognition (asked to work offline, using your offline language packs), or the built-in Whisper model %1$s (English) run by whisper.cpp (MIT licence).\nInternet access: none. Spokify does not request it.\nWith the Whisper engine, audio is kept in memory only and discarded after each dictation. With the Phone engine, the phone\'s speech service does the listening.
